about: Every file that aws-migration changes compared to main, in a path that deploys or runs by itself after a merge (scripts/check-merge-safe.mjs). Each names the switch that keeps it from changing anything. A fingerprint is what the branch changes in that file, so any later change fails until someone reviews it and updates the fingerprint.

convex/_generated/api.d.ts.why: Types for the sync's routes, edited by hand; regenerated at the first Convex deploy

convex/http.ts.why: Registers the sync's routes, which refuse everyone while it's unset

convex/lib/http.ts.why: Adds the sync's secret header; the other routes are untouched

convex/lib/syncRoutes.ts.why: New routes, read-only, 401 before the body is read

convex/syncRead.ts.why: New internal queries, reached only through those routes

pipeline/Dockerfile.switch: none needed: the image, not the laptop
pipeline/Dockerfile.why: Adds queue mode's packages and RDS's certificates. Nothing builds this on a merge, and its entry point stays Convex mode

pipeline/observability.py.switch: SENTRY_DSN_WORKER and DEPLOY_ENV, and the package
pipeline/observability.py.why: New; does nothing without all three (test_worker_no_sentry.py)

pipeline/publish.py.why: Only queue mode's S3 bucket has it, so GCS links don't change

pipeline/worker.py.switch: SENTRY_DSN_WORKER and DEPLOY_ENV, and the package
pipeline/worker.py.why: Two Sentry calls, both no-ops on the laptop

web/next.config.ts.why: Gives the switch a value in every build, so the new flow compiles out

web/src/components/dish/parts.tsx.why: The audio reload runs only with it set

web/src/components/miss/CardScreen.tsx.why: Hands useAudio its reload, which parts.tsx ignores with it unset

web/src/lib/dish/api.ts.why: Upload links with it set, raw files to Convex without
